info.title: MultiDB Control Plane API
info.description: Public HTTP contract for the MultiDB Control Plane API v1.

servers.description: Local Docker or multidb serve runtime

get.summary: Return the Control Plane OpenAPI v1 document.

400.description: Invalid JSON (`invalid_json`), or a username over 256 bytes or password over 1024 bytes (`invalid_value`).

503.description: Too many concurrent password checks (`auth_busy`). The response carries `Retry-After: 1` and the attempt is not counted as a failure.

400.description: Invalid JSON (`invalid_json`), an empty new password, or a password over 1024 bytes (`invalid_value`).

503.description: Too many concurrent password checks (`auth_busy`). The response carries `Retry-After: 1`.

put.summary: Update a table row by primary key.

delete.summary: Delete a table row after exact confirmation.
Delete a collection document after exact confirmation.

requires_gpu.description: True when opening the canonical storage profile requires a supported native GPU adapter. Optional for compatibility with earlier API v1 servers.

TensorData.description: Exactly one dtype-tagged array. Numeric values must be finite. These typed tensor values are stored in binary chunks, not as arbitrary JSON document blobs.

shape.description: Per-sample shape; [] is a scalar. Product must match data length and not exceed 4,000,000 elements.

name.description: At most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

shape.description: Per-sample schema; null is a ragged dimension. For example [null,null,3] allows differently sized RGB images.

name.description: At most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

propertyNames.description: At most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

TensorBatch.description: A sample array for every dataset column. All columns must contain the same number of samples; dtype and shape must match the schema. Append is atomic; decoded tensor batches are also capped at 64 MiB.

propertyNames.description: At most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

items.description: At most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

TensorReadRequest.description: Reads a bounded sample range from the current immutable append snapshot or an explicit retained revision. Maximum decoded result: 64 MiB.

tensor.description: At most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

TensorSearchRequest.description: Exact bounded distance search over a fixed rank-one numeric tensor column. Query values must be finite and dimension-matched. Tensor-profile execution requires the real GPU backend; other profiles expose the CPU reference device explicitly.

tensor.description: At most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

TensorComputeRequest.description: Bounded per-sample reduction. The execution field identifies the actual device and backend. No automatic ML inference or training is performed.

vector_collection.description: Vector collection name, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

graph.description: Graph name, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

query_vector.description: Finite values; dimension must match the vector collection. No zero vector for cosine distance.

max_context_bytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in the returned context.

labels.description: Outgoing edge labels, each at most 128 UTF-8 bytes. Traversal sorts and deduplicates them.

text_field.description: Metadata field path; each segment is at most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

source_field.description: Metadata field path; each segment is at most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

document_id.description: Canonical vector document ID: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

source.description: Optional metadata provenance, clipped to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

seed_id.description: Canonical vector document ID: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

source.description: Canonical vector document ID: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

target.description: Canonical vector document ID: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

context.description: Policy-filtered, masked retrieval context; at most max_context_bytes UTF-8 bytes.

source.description: Graph node ID, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. Use the vector endpoint document ID unchanged for GraphRAG.

label.description: Edge label, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

target.description: Graph node ID; GraphRAG document nodes use canonical lowercase hex IDs.

ErrorEnvelopeWithData.description: Enveloped error. For provisioning errors `data` carries the plan, the apply report, the validation report or the confirmed and current plan ids, when there is one.

ProvisionOptions.description: Per-run provisioning options; part of the prov_ plan id, so an apply must repeat the options of the plan it confirms.

confirm.description: The prov_ id of the reviewed plan. The server recomputes the plan and applies it only when the id is still current; without it the plan is returned with 422 confirmation_required (a noop needs no confirmation).

ProvisionPlan.description: A provisioning plan of the served database (see docs/provisioning.md).

DriftReport.description: How the served database differs from a spec.

TensorDatasetConfig.description: The shared HTTP request body limit is 1 MiB, including JSON encoding. Binary chunk storage limits do not enlarge this HTTP cap.

ProfilesEnvelope.description: Built-in profiles, storage variants and GPU requirements.

JsonObjectOrErrorEnvelope.description: Enveloped JSON response or enveloped error response

ProvisionErrorEnvelope.description: Enveloped error response; data carries the plan, the apply report, the validation report or the plan ids, when there is one

createTensorDataset.description: Preview. Requires Collection(name):Admin. Native single-node storage only. The Tensor profile requires a real GPU at startup; unsupported non-tensor builders are rejected on that profile. Tensor contents use dtype-tagged arrays, not arbitrary JSON documents. The shared HTTP body limit is 1 MiB.

422.description: tensor_unsupported: backend/profile is unsupported; tensor_gpu_unsupported: dtype, shape or GPU memory bounds are unsupported.

503.description: busy (query governor, Retry-After: 1) or tensor_gpu_unavailable (required adapter unavailable); GPU work is never silently run on the CPU.

getTensorDataset.summary: Read tensor dataset metadata and revision.
getTensorDataset.description: Preview. Requires Collection(name):Read. Bounded immutable metadata lookup, without scanning sample chunks. Tensor contents use dtype-tagged arrays, not arbitrary JSON documents. The shared HTTP body limit is 1 MiB.

422.description: tensor_unsupported: backend/profile is unsupported; tensor_gpu_unsupported: dtype, shape or GPU memory bounds are unsupported.

503.description: busy (query governor, Retry-After: 1) or tensor_gpu_unavailable (required adapter unavailable); GPU work is never silently run on the CPU.

appendTensors.summary: Atomically append a typed tensor batch.
appendTensors.description: Preview. Requires Collection(name):Write. All configured columns must be present with equal sample counts. The append creates a new immutable revision. Tensor contents use dtype-tagged arrays, not arbitrary JSON documents. The shared HTTP body limit is 1 MiB.

422.description: tensor_unsupported: backend/profile is unsupported; tensor_gpu_unsupported: dtype, shape or GPU memory bounds are unsupported.

503.description: busy (query governor, Retry-After: 1) or tensor_gpu_unavailable (required adapter unavailable); GPU work is never silently run on the CPU.

readTensors.summary: Read a projected tensor sample range.
readTensors.description: Preview. Requires Collection(name):Read. Supports fixed and ragged shapes and immutable revision selection. Row/masking policies are unsupported and fail closed. Tensor contents use dtype-tagged arrays, not arbitrary JSON documents. The shared HTTP body limit is 1 MiB.

422.description: tensor_unsupported: backend/profile is unsupported; tensor_gpu_unsupported: dtype, shape or GPU memory bounds are unsupported.

503.description: busy (query governor, Retry-After: 1) or tensor_gpu_unavailable (required adapter unavailable); GPU work is never silently run on the CPU.

searchTensors.summary: Search a bounded tensor embedding range.
searchTensors.description: Preview. Requires Collection(name):Read. Returns exact distances and execution provenance. Tensor-profile requests run on the real GPU backend with no silent CPU fallback. This is retrieval, not automatic model inference. Tensor contents use dtype-tagged arrays, not arbitrary JSON documents. The shared HTTP body limit is 1 MiB.

422.description: tensor_unsupported: backend/profile is unsupported; tensor_gpu_unsupported: dtype, shape or GPU memory bounds are unsupported.

503.description: busy (query governor, Retry-After: 1) or tensor_gpu_unavailable (required adapter unavailable); GPU work is never silently run on the CPU.

computeTensors.description: Preview. Requires Collection(name):Read. sum, mean and l2_norm operate per sample. The execution object identifies the actual GPU adapter/backend, or an explicit CPU reference execution on other profiles. GPU unavailability returns 503 tensor_gpu_unavailable; there is no silent fallback. Tensor contents use dtype-tagged arrays, not arbitrary JSON documents. The shared HTTP body limit is 1 MiB.

422.description: tensor_unsupported: backend/profile is unsupported; tensor_gpu_unsupported: dtype, shape or GPU memory bounds are unsupported.

503.description: busy (query governor, Retry-After: 1) or tensor_gpu_unavailable (required adapter unavailable); GPU work is never silently run on the CPU.

queryGraphRag.summary: Retrieve context with vector seeds and bounded graph expansion.
queryGraphRag.description: Preview for single-node/embedded databases; AP and sharded backends return 422 graphrag_unsupported. Requires Read on both the named vector collection and graph. Returns retrieval context and provenance; does not call an LLM or generate an answer. Row policies filter metadata before traversal; masking applies before context assembly. Graph document node IDs are the vector API lowercase hexadecimal document IDs. Missing objects return 404; invalid bounds, vector dimensions or non-finite values return 400.

422.description: graphrag_unsupported: AP or sharded backend cannot provide bounded scans.

503.description: Query governor busy; retry after the indicated delay.

addGraphEdge.summary: Insert or replace a directed graph edge.
addGraphEdge.description: Preview. Requires Write on the named graph. For GraphRAG, pass the lowercase document IDs returned by vector insertion as source and target. Other string node IDs remain usable by the generic graph API.

503.description: Query governor busy; retry after the indicated delay.

searchVector.description: Requires Read on the named vector collection. Applies row filters to stored metadata and then masks returned metadata; hidden or missing documents are omitted, so the result can contain fewer than k hits. Unreadable policy metadata fails closed.

getConfig.description: Legacy: a version 1 spec built from the database configuration only (no collections). GET /config/live describes the served database as a spec.

applyConfig.summary: Confirm and audit a planned config change.
applyConfig.description: Audit-only (data_mutated: false). The body is {plan, confirm}, a plan the client computed (audited as plan_source: client), or {current, desired, confirm}, from which the server recomputes the plan as POST /config/plan does (audited as plan_source: recomputed). Provisioning is POST /provision/apply.

getLiveConfig.summary: Return the served database as a DatabaseSpec.
getLiveConfig.description: The spec the last provisioning apply recorded (source applied_record), or a version 2 spec inferred from the catalog, profile manifest, RBAC and audit state (source inferred), with notes and the live fingerprint. Requires System:Admin.

getProvisionState.summary: Return what provisioning manages in the served database.
getProvisionState.description: The provision record, its history, the profile manifest, the live fingerprint and, when multidb serve runs in spec mode, the spec digest and MULTIDB_SPEC_APPLY mode. Requires System:Admin.

planProvision.summary: Plan a spec against the served database.
planProvision.description: A dry run on the control_plane surface; nothing is written. Ready, noop and needs_flags plans are 200; a blocked plan or an invalid spec is 422 with the plan in data (codes invalid_spec, provision_blocked, audit_required, rbac_self_lockout); an unsupported spec version is 422 invalid_spec_version; a storage error or an unreadable provision record is 500. Requires System:Admin.

applyProvision.summary: Apply a spec to the served database.
applyProvision.description: Recomputes the plan and applies it as the calling principal (System:Admin and Database:Admin) when confirm is its current prov_ id; there is no client plan. 409 plan_changed when the id is no longer current, or object_conflict when a create met an existing object; 422 confirmation_required, flags_required, provision_blocked, invalid_spec, audit_required or rbac_self_lockout, with the plan or report in data; 500 provision_partially_applied with the report. Retunes and the storage format upgrade take effect at the next restart (session_pending_restart).

checkProvisionDrift.summary: Report how the served database differs from a spec.
checkProvisionDrift.description: The drift of the control_plane plan of the spec; 422 invalid_spec with the validation report in data for an invalid spec; a storage error or an unreadable provision record is 500. Requires System:Admin.

planAdvice.summary: Return the dry-run plan for an advice item.

getStudioManifest.summary: Return Studio and client capability metadata.
getStudioManifest.description: provisioning_supported is true when the /provision/* endpoints are served (capability provision_apply).
